name: AZRedirect
description: Force-redirects anonymous visitors to the Azure AD (Entra ID) OpenID Connect login flow on every non-login route.
project_description: AZRedirect is a small glue module that automatically redirects anonymous users to the Microsoft Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) login page when they try to access a Drupal site. When its single 'Login route' setting is enabled, a kernel request subscriber intercepts every anonymous request (except the core login/password-reset and OpenID Connect callback routes) and starts the OpenID Connect authorize flow against the hard-coded 'windows_aad' client provided by the openid_connect_windows_aad module. It provides one admin settings form and no entities, permissions, plugins or Drush commands of its own; all authentication is delegated to OpenID Connect.
